samples.question: The picture shows four flat drawings on white paper: one black drawing and three coloured drawings, one red, one green and one blue. Each drawing is made only of solid blobs of its own single colour. Two blobs of the same colour that do not touch anywhere are separate PIECES. A round patch of white paper that lies completely inside one blob, so that its white is fully surrounded by that colour, is a HOLE. For each drawing count its pieces and count its holes, adding the holes of all of its pieces together. Exactly one of the red, green and blue drawings has BOTH the same number of pieces AND the same number of holes as the black drawing; of the other two, one matches the black drawing only in its number of pieces and the other only in its number of holes. Position, size, blob shape and total amount of ink are irrelevant. Which coloured drawing matches the black drawing in both numbers? Answer red, green or blue.
